cmd:
TOK=$(grep GITHUB_TOKEN= /etc/vps-github-bridge/token | head -1 | cut -d= -f2)
D=/opt/trading-bot/classic
curl -sfH "Authorization: token $TOK" -H "Accept: application/vnd.github.raw" "https://api.github.com/repos/ruslan591/weather-_Odessa/contents/bot/classic/hand_e2e.py" -o /tmp/hand_e2e.py
sudo -u tbot /opt/trading-bot/venv/bin/python /tmp/hand_e2e.py 2>&1 | tail -n 14
rm -f $D/hand.json $D/trendline_learned.json; systemctl restart classicbot; sleep 6; systemctl is-active classicbot
